text: There's a hidden one-handed keyboard in the latest version of iOS — here's how to turn it on (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jan 1, 2018, 9:15 am 42 pts Apple's newer iPhones have bigger screen sizes, making them more difficult to use with one hand. But there's a hidden one-handed keyboard mode in the latest version of iOS that could help. If you've been struggling with the bigger iPhone sizes, here's a trick that could change how you use your…
